items.appliesWhen: No other component has a defaultMonth input, so the rename is unambiguous.
items.note: Behaviour is unchanged: the input always took a full Date, and the calendar still opens on its month with grid focus on its exact day — only while the value is empty, and never written into the value.

items.action: None, unless a passive table must keep its hover tint. To keep it: `ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background-color: var(--surface-secondary); }`.
items.appliesWhen: Tables that already set `rowInteractive` need nothing — they keep the tint and gain a pressed fill.
items.pitfall: Nothing compiles differently, so this only shows on screen. A table that reads as clickable because of the hover tint, without ever having been clickable, quietly loses the affordance it should not have had.
items.note: The row hover tint is rendered only when `rowInteractive` is set; clickable rows also gain a pressed `:active` fill through `--ds-table-row-pressed-bg-color`.
items.restore: ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background-color: var(--surface-secondary); }
items.verify: Every table whose rows are clickable sets [rowInteractive] (that is what draws the tint now), and a passive table that must keep an always-on hover carries the restore rule deliberately.

items.action: Build the consumer immediately after the bump — the compiler enumerates every collision. Per member: where the base means the same thing, keep the name and add `override` with a base-compatible signature; otherwise rename your own member. Base members it collides on: zebra, columnOrder, orderedColumns, visibleColumns, toggleColumn, onColumnDrop, moveColumn, resetColumns, columnFilters, exportCsv, onResizeMove, onResizeEnd.
items.appliesWhen: Only a consumer that EXTENDS TableComponent or another class in `detect`. Subclassing a DS component is unsupported; anyone using the `<ds-table>` element is unaffected.
items.pitfall: Two ways to fix it wrongly. Adding `override` to `zebra` without adopting the base booleanAttribute transform changes what the input accepts. And renaming your member to something else can collide again — check the new name against the base member list, because the private and protected ones are internal and give no warning.
items.note: With the new column API `TableComponent` gained 77, so a subclass that already used one of those names stops compiling: TS4114 wants an `override` modifier, TS2416 fires where the signature differs. `DatePickerComponent` gained `defaultDate` and lost `defaultMonth`. `MultiSelectComponent` and `TimePickerComponent` each gained `onTriggerClick`. `PopoverComponent` gained `focusTimer`, `panelTrap` and `triggerElement`. `SelectComponent` gained `host`. `SidenavComponent` gained `brandNameRef`, `hasBrandName` and `logoLetter`.
items.verify: A typecheck reports no TS4114 / TS2416 on a TableComponent subclass; every kept name uses `override` with a base-compatible signature.

informational: ds-table gains an opt-in rowActions kebab (⋮) column with a rowActionSelected output and new TableRowAction/TableRowActionEvent types — additive, off by default (no rowActions input = no column), no code change.

ds-table gains opt-in activeRowId (current-row highlight + aria-current, --ds-table-row-active-bg-color token) and filterQuery (client-side substring filter; TableColumn.filterable restricts the match set) inputs — additive, off by default, no code change.

TableColumn.width / .truncate / .hidden were declared but ignored — they now take effect (header width px, ellipsis clip at width with title tooltip, column skipped). Consumers who set these fields expecting nothing will see them start working.

TableColumn.hideable now works too: hideable columns surface a header column-picker button (checkbox popover, last visible column locked); new two-way hiddenKeys model (Set<string> | null, null derives from hidden flags) — additive, no picker unless a column sets hideable.

ds-table gains inline cell editing: columns with editable:true become a text input on double-click (Enter/blur commit, Escape cancel); the table emits cellEdited {row,key,value} (new TableCellEditEvent type) and the consumer applies the update — additive, off by default, no code change.

ds-table gains per-column set filters: a column with filter:'set' shows a header funnel with a searchable checkbox list of distinct values; new two-way columnFilters model (Map<key, Set<value>>) combines with filterQuery — additive, off by default, no code change.
ds-table gains opt-in resizableColumns (drag handles on header right edges) and a two-way columnWidths model (Map<key, px>, seeded from column.width) — additive, off by default, no code change.

ds-table gains opt-in reorderableColumns (drag handle + up/down in the column panel, which now lists all columns) and a two-way columnOrder model (string[] | null, null = declaration order); the panel's Reset to default resets all three column models — order, visibility and widths (columnOrder, hiddenKeys, columnWidths) — additive, off by default, no code change.
ds-table gains a public exportCsv(filename?) method — downloads visible columns of the filtered+sorted rows as UTF-8 CSV, wired to a consumer button via template ref — additive, no code change.

ds-table gains opt-in density ('default'|'compact'), zebra (odd-row stripe via new --ds-table-row-stripe-bg-color token) and maxHeight (caps + vertically scrolls the body, pairs with stickyHeader) inputs — additive, off by default, no code change.

ds-table gains an opt-in stickyScrollbar input — the scroll container's native horizontal bar is hidden and a proxy stuck to the bottom of the nearest scroll ancestor mirrors scrollLeft both ways (hides itself when nothing overflows) — additive, off by default, no code change.

ds-table truncate cells: clicking a clipped cell now opens the full value in a popover (in addition to the title tooltip; the click is swallowed, never doubling as a row click; unclipped cells pass the click to the row) — behavior only, no code change.

ds-table rowInteractive: a click that finishes a mouse text selection no longer emits rowClicked, so cell text can be drag-selected and copied (only a selection made by that same gesture counts — a stale selection never blocks clicks); keyboard activation unaffected — behavior only, no code change.

ds-select/ds-autocomplete/ds-multi-select/ds-time-picker/ds-color-picker/ds-popover overlay panels are now non-modal (no backdrop): the page behind stays interactive, panels close on outside pointer-down or page scroll, button-style triggers toggle, and focus returns to the trigger only for Escape/selection/in-panel closes — behavior only, no code change.

ds-date-picker no longer strands focus on <body> when the calendar closes via outside click or page scroll — close() now returns focus to the field (preventScroll) when focus was inside the calendar, except a coarse-pointer device with an editable field (allowInput) which is left alone to avoid re-summoning the soft keyboard (allowInput=false always refocuses); Escape/selection/preset closes unchanged — pure bugfix, no code change.
ds-toast enter animation now slides up from below into place (exit unchanged) — visual/motion only, no code change.

Typography utilities .t-* (.t-display/.t-h1…/.t-mono-block) now read each type property as a longhand through a public --ds-t-<name>-<prop> hook (font-weight/font-size/line-height/font-family + letter-spacing/text-transform/color/background-color/border-color/border-radius where set), falling back to the current semantic token — consumers can retune a single axis per utility in a scope without forking. Default rendering unchanged; structural box props stay raw. The font shorthand became longhands, so .t-* no longer force font-style/font-variant back to normal - observable only inside an italic or small-caps ancestor. Additive, no code change.

ds-input/ds-search/ds-textarea now focus the inner input/textarea when the frame chrome is clicked (leading/trailing icon, prefix/suffix add-on, padding); nested controls (projected buttons, clear x, password toggle) keep their own click. New exported FieldClickFocusDirective ([dsFieldClickFocus]) for consumers' own field wrappers. Overlay-trigger fields already focused on click and are unchanged — behavior only, no code change.

New ds-app-shell — a slotted fixed-frame application shell ([sidenav]/[topbar]/default content slots) that pins to the viewport (100dvh, overflow: hidden) so only the content <main> scrolls (scrollbar-gutter: stable + automatic native-scrollbar-width padding compensation via the new --ds-scrollbar-width root variable); topbarSpan input ('content' default full-height rail | 'full' full-width topbar) switches the geometry; scroll-to-top on router navigation via the new exported ShellScrollService (also injectable from routed pages for manual scrollToTop()). Tokens: --ds-app-shell-pad-x/-pad-y/-content-max-width/-height — additive, no code change.

New ds-sidenav-footer — a rail footer brick: Search row with a live grouped-results popover, Alerts row with an unread dot + feed popover, Collapse row, and a user card with an account menu; inputs userName/userRole/alerts/collapsed/searchProvider/alertItems/profileRoute, outputs collapseToggled/alertsOpened/signOutSelected; new exported types SidenavSearchProvider/SidenavSearchResult/SidenavAlertItem. Tokens: --ds-sidenav-footer-popover-width/-popover-max-width/-popover-max-height/-head-tracking/-dot-size — additive, no code change.

ds-sidenav gains an optional logoLetter input (sets the brand-tile glyph when it differs from the brand's first letter) and a [dsBrandName] projection slot (exported marker directive BrandNameDirective) that renders custom wordmark markup inside .brand-name in place of the plain brand text — both optional, omitting them renders exactly as before, additive, no code change.
